title: Python
focus: Python from the ground up, by hand and idiomatic: the data model, comprehensions, functions and closures, decorators, classes and dataclasses, iterators and generators, typing, errors and context managers, the standard library, asyncio and pytest, then data structures, algorithms and backend design at big tech interview level.
ladder: Language basics: strings, lists, dicts, sets, tuples, slicing, loops
Comprehensions, unpacking and the standard library: collections, itertools, functools
Classes, dataclasses, dunder methods and protocols
Type hints, errors and custom exceptions, testing with pytest
asyncio: coroutines, gather, timeouts, semaphores, queues
Data structures and algorithms: hash maps, two pointers, heaps, stacks, trees, graphs

Interview level at Amazon, Zillow or Capital One: multi part problems like an LRU cache with TTL, a rate limiter, transaction fraud windows, a home price index over listings, under real complexity limits
